steps.eval: (()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const m=f.meter; if(m.phase===1){ m.t=(m.power-0.07)/1.25-0.1; __rhf.press('primary'); } return 'phase '+m.phase+' power '+m.power.toFixed(2)})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<1500;i++){ if(f.state!=='fight') break; const F=f.fight; F.stamina=Math.min(F.stamina,0.3); const hold = F.state!=='run' && F.state!=='jump' && F.tension/f.rod().maxTension < 0.85; __rhf.hold('primary', hold); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); } __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'state '+f.state})()
